violation.method: native triangle vs original hand-local mouth box shrunk2micrometres

elbow_policy.frame: actor local; actual native S=upper joint,E=forearm joint,W=hand joint; signed bend around pre-swivel upper-arm X
elbow_policy.scope: Targeted front low-reach regression, not a universal anatomical certificate

adjacent_shoulder_seam_observations.scope: Exact upper-sleeve vs shoulder-band/shirt/vest mesh pairs reported separately as proximal junction observations; not a clearance proof or head waiver.

native_clearance.method: Original Float32 GLB vertices transformed by actual runtime mesh.matrixWorld; connected surfaces prune AABBs only. Up to16 triangle-centroid probes/component/direction shifted250micrometres inward; both ENTIRE original meshes must have |winding|>2pi and nearest-surface depth>2micrometres. Nonadjacent body/workcell positive witnesses block this gate; exact proximal junction observations are listed separately.
native_clearance.exclusions: Role badge is nonphysical; internal right-arm mesh pairs are excluded but original C-mouth box is checked independently at every dense frame. Exact upper-sleeve/adjacent shoulder-band/shirt/vest pairs are reported separately; head/ears/neck/legs and all other nonadjacent body parts are never waived. All6arm meshes vs all22otherbody+fixedfixture sampled; proximal arm vs head additionally at482prep poses/version. No whole-warehouse or continuous certificate.

limitations: No Blender/source mesh changes or renderer used.
No sampled witness is not proof of complete clearance; thin/unsampled/between-pose intersections may remain.
Historical endpoint metadata is not refreshed or promoted to current acceptance.
